text.description_html:
Fusion BU-G8, Sandcast Brass Nevada Lever with Silver Mine Rectangular Rose

This leverset has an oil-rubbed bronze finish which emphasizes the rustic beauty of the sandcast brass material from which this leverset has been carefully crafted. The Nevada Lever with the Silver Mine Plate feature strait lines that offset the happy imperfections that sandcasting creates. The 6-5/8" high by 2-5/8" wide Silver Mine rose is bigger than most, so as to make a statement that won't be over-taken by the surrounding decor. This leverset can stand up to boldly painted or large doors while adding its own character. It is available in either a 2-3/8" or a 2-3/4" backset; and will adjust to door thicknesses from 1-1/4" to 2".

Also Available Matching Silver Mine Rose with Egg Knob

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten Brass is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Features for the Fusion BU Nevada Lever With G8 Silver Mine Plate:

  • Solid Brass Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • Exclusive Fusion lever spring assembly for lifetime performance
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts

Specifications for Silver Mine Rose with Nevada Lever:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Lever Length: 4-1/8"
  • Lever Projection: 1-7/8"
  • Rose Length: 6-5/8"
  • Rose Width: 2-5/8"
  • Rose Projection: 1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: Either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.
  • One Year Finish Warranty.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: Non-functional pull to match trim on one side of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Dummy Set: Non-functional pull to match trim on both sides of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
